description: Merge cosigners' partially signed PSBTs (base64 or hex) for the same transaction and finalize once the threshold is met. Returns signed_tx (hex of the finalized tx, ready for the user's own broadcast) and psbt (base64 of the combined PSBT). Errors: no_psbts, not_a_psbt, psbts_do_not_combine, not_enough_signatures. Signs nothing and broadcasts nothing. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: combine_psbts
title: Combine cosigner PSBTs and finalize (dev tool)
